lines.zh: 我的脚步让地面轻微凹陷
lines.en: My steps dent the ground slightly
I walk straight and never turn aside

lines.zh: 我经过的窗子自己关了
lines.en: The windows I pass close themselves

lines.zh: 我一个身位一个身位压来
lines.en: I bear down a body's width at a time
My body is wider than the corridor
My shadow arrives before I do

lines.zh: 我踩过的草都朝一边倒
lines.en: The grass I tread all leans one way
The air grows heavy around me
I keep walking in your direction
I do not hurry, the road yields to me

lines.zh: 我所到之处影子都偏了方向
lines.en: Everywhere I go shadows point the wrong way
One stride carries me the length of the corridor

lines.zh: 我站着，整个房间都在震
lines.en: I stand and the whole room trembles
I hang my hands and stay motionless

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让天花板掉灰
lines.en: My breathing knocks dust off the ceiling
I wait, however long it takes
My presence presses very solidly
I do not need to move at all

lines.zh: 墙壁因为我而发出声音
lines.en: The walls make sounds because of me
I am here, and here is wrong
I turn my head once

lines.zh: 时间在我旁边过得很慢
lines.en: Time passes slowly beside me

lines.zh: 我把手放在墙上，墙就冷了
lines.en: I put my hand on the wall and it goes cold
My shadow stays still in the corner

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，声音却一直在
lines.en: I need no breath, yet the sound goes on
I wait behind your door
You are looking at me, I know.

lines.zh: 你想确认我是不是真的
lines.en: You want to confirm whether I am real
The answer does not matter
I have written your name down
You cannot back away that far
A thousand points of me, think it over
I record everything you say
Do you want to run again

lines.zh: 我的脸你记不住是对的
lines.en: It is right that you cannot remember my face
We have met many times
I can smell the sweat in your palms
The more you look, the less you see me
I do not need eyes to see you

lines.zh: 你的迟疑已经很清楚了
lines.en: Your hesitation is very clear
You raised your head too slowly

lines.zh: 我看见你的手在找出口
lines.en: I see your hands looking for an exit

lines.zh: 这个距离正好够我看着你
lines.en: This distance is just right for watching you

lines.zh: 你的眼睛已经适应黑暗了
lines.en: Your eyes have adjusted to the dark

lines.zh: 你还没明白发生了什么
lines.en: You have not understood what is happening

lines.zh: 我的脸是你能想起的最坏的东西
lines.en: My face is the worst thing you can recall

lines.zh: 我受了伤，但你没有看见伤口
lines.en: I was hurt, but you see no wound
This damage is not enough for me

lines.zh: 我的形状晃了一下又定了
lines.en: My shape wavered then settled
A thousand points is not written for nothing
The place you struck is closing

lines.zh: 你听见的那声是我在笑
lines.en: That sound you heard was me laughing

lines.zh: 我向后退了一步，只一步
lines.en: I stepped back once, only once
The house shook with me
The warmth in your hands dropped
I am still right here
That sort of thing is useless to me
You hold it up as if to block wind
I do not eat, and I have no need
You thought I would have desires
Put it down, your arm will tire

lines.zh: 我的注意力从来不在这个上
lines.en: My attention was never on such things
You may try, I will not stop you
This thing cannot stop me

lines.zh: 你手里的东西开始变冷了
lines.en: What you hold is growing cold
Put that thing away

lines.zh: 你撞上来了，我连晃都没晃
lines.en: You struck me, I did not even sway
My hand rests on top of your head
One touch and you know

lines.zh: 我们的重量不是一个级别的
lines.en: Our weights are not in the same class
You were pushed away, I did not move

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下凹了一点
lines.en: The ground dented a little under me
You retreated quickly

lines.zh: 我的手印留在你的肩上
lines.en: My handprint stays on your shoulder
You will bump into me again

lines.zh: 我这种东西不需要那些
lines.en: A thing like me has no need of that
A thousand-point body does not propagate
That question disappoints me

lines.zh: 我存在的方式跟你不一样
lines.en: My way of existing differs from yours

lines.zh: 别把人的规矩套在我身上
lines.en: Do not fit human rules onto me
I only need you to be here
I do not need a second
Such thoughts do not suit you
I still watch you without moving

lines.zh: 这个答案你已经知道了
lines.en: You already know this answer

lines.zh: 我把它拿起来，它开始变形
lines.en: I pick it up and it begins to warp
It has no weight in my hand
This thing belongs to me now

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我替你收着
lines.en: I will keep what you dropped
It turns ice cold in my palm
I look at it and it cracks
I lift it between two fingers
I do not need it, but I took it
It crumbles to ash in my hand
Giving it back would be useless
Your heartbeat has gone irregular
I raised one hand
This place belongs to me now
I am in no hurry, and you cannot escape

lines.zh: 我一直在等你自己走进来
lines.en: I have been waiting for you to walk in
Your breathing is growing faint
Let me see how long you hold
There will not be a second time

lines.zh: 我的名字，被乱码盖住了。
lines.en: My name is covered in scrambled text.

lines.zh: 我看得见你所有的选择
lines.en: I can see every choice you have
You chose this path

lines.zh: 你听见了，却还是往前走
lines.en: You heard it, and still walked on

lines.zh: 门把手在你手里转不动
lines.en: The knob will not turn in your hand

lines.zh: 我说的每个字你都记住了
lines.en: You remember every word I say
I follow you slowly

lines.zh: 你跑到哪里都在我的范围
lines.en: Wherever you run, you are in my range
I need no speed
The walls will block you for me

lines.zh: 我在你想不到的方向出现
lines.en: I appear where you do not expect

lines.zh: 你听见的每一声都离得不远
lines.en: Every sound you hear is not far
I do not blink, I have no eyelids
I am counting how many seconds you have left
My shadow covers the ground
You locked the door, good

lines.zh: 这个房间没有别的出口
lines.en: This room has no other exit

lines.zh: 你的手在门把上，我看见了
lines.en: Your hand is on the knob, I see it
I do not need to break the door down

lines.zh: 我从这里就能到你那里
lines.en: I can reach you from here

lines.zh: 你转身的时候会看到我
lines.en: When you turn, you will see me
I have waited long for this

lines.zh: 我把你的名字念了一遍
lines.en: I said your name once aloud

lines.zh: 你不必回头，我知道你在
lines.en: You need not look back, I know you are there
This room is smaller than yesterday
I watch you from inside the wall
My hand comes down
This one needs no force
You are pressed to the ground
I did not speed up, I only came closer
A crack is pressed into the floor

lines.zh: 这一击之后房间安静了
lines.en: After this blow the room is quiet
You struggled once in my grip
I let go, and you are still down
I do not need a second blow
I hold your shoulder, very steadily

lines.zh: 你反抗的力气被我吃掉了
lines.en: I swallowed the strength of your struggle
I used very little for this one

lines.zh: 你的骨头在我的手里很轻
lines.en: Your bones are light in my hand
I set you back on the ground
I will not let you go too quickly
I have appeared here

lines.zh: 这间屋子开始下沉一点
lines.en: This room sinks a little

lines.zh: 我先出现在你想不到的地方
lines.en: I appear where you would not think
A thousand points of weight settles
The air has been pushed aside
Your name is in my mouth
I need no introduction
The corridor lights went out on their own
I have always been of this place
Turn around and you will see

lines.zh: 周围的声音全被我吞掉
lines.en: Every sound around is swallowed
I come through from the other side of the wall

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变快了，我听见了
lines.en: Your breathing quickened, I heard it

lines.zh: 这栋房子的影子都朝着我
lines.en: Every shadow in this house points at me
I have blocked the light at the doorway

lines.zh: 我一直在这个世界的另一边
lines.en: I have always been on the other side of this world

lines.zh: 你数一数房间里有几个人
lines.en: Count how many people are in this room
I am a little closer than yesterday

lines.zh: 你听见的那三下敲门是我
lines.en: Those three knocks were mine
I have memorized this whole place

lines.zh: 火在我身上像是被吸进去了
lines.en: The fire on me seems to be drawn in

lines.zh: 我落下去的时候，地面先塌了
lines.en: The ground gave way before I fell
Water cannot fill this hollow of mine
The blast dispersed into wind on me

lines.zh: 那东西进不来，停在半途
lines.en: It could not enter, it stopped halfway

lines.zh: 那股术力在我周围碎掉了
lines.en: That magic shattered around me

lines.zh: 我不需要吃，这你也知道
lines.en: I need no food, you know that

lines.zh: 雷光里我的轮廓更清楚了
lines.en: In the lightning my outline grew clearer

lines.zh: 这里的空连我也装不下
lines.en: Even I cannot fill this emptiness
